mil5.4.1:1.2: Etad-aggaṃ bhikkhave mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ iddhimantānaṃ, yad-idaṃ Mahāmoggallāno ti.
mil5.4.1:1.3: Puna ca kira so laguḷehi paripothito bhinnasīso sañcuṇṇitaṭṭhi maṃsa-dhamani-majja-parikatto parinibbuto.
mil5.4.1:1.4: Yadi bhante Nāgasena thero Mahāmoggallāno iddhiyā koṭiṃ gato, tena hi: laguḷehi paripothito parinibbuto ti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.4.1:1.5: Yadi laguḷehi paripothito parinibbuto, tena hi: iddhiyā koṭiṃ gato ti tam-pi vacanaṃ micchā.
mil5.4.1:1.6: Kin-na samattho iddhiyā attano upaghātaṃ apanayituṃ, sadevakassa pi lokassa paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavituṃ araho ti.
mil5.4.1:1.7: Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.4.1:2.2: Etad-aggaṃ bhikkhave mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ iddhimantānaṃ, yad-idaṃ Mahāmoggallāno ti.
mil5.4.1:2.3: Āyasmā ca Mahāmoggallāno laguḷahato parinibbuto, tañ-ca pana kammādhiggahitenāti. -
mil5.4.1:3.1: Nanu bhante Nāgasena iddhimato iddhivisayo pi kammavipāko pi dve acintiyā, acintiyena acintiyaṃ apanayitabbaṃ.
mil5.4.1:3.2: Yathā nāma bhante keci phalakāmā kapitthena kapitthaṃ pothenti, ambena ambaṃ pothenti,
mil5.4.1:3.3: evam-eva kho bhante Nāgasena acintiyena acintiyaṃ pothayitvā apanetabban-ti. -
mil5.4.1:3.5: Yathā mahārāja mahiyā rājāno honti samajaccā, samajaccānam-pi tesaṃ eko sabbe abhibhavitvā āṇaṃ pavatteti,
mil5.4.1:3.6: evam-eva kho mahārāja tesaṃ acintiyānaṃ kammavipākaṃ yeva adhimattaṃ balavataraṃ, kammavipākaṃ yeva sabbe abhibhaviya āṇaṃ pavatteti, kammādhiggahitassa avasesā kiriyā okāsaṃ na labhanti.
mil5.4.1:4.1: Idha pana mahārāja koci puriso kismicid-eva pakaraṇe aparajjhati, na tassa mātā vā pitā vā bhagini-bhātaro vā sakhi-sahāyakā vā tāyanti, atha kho rājā yeva tattha abhibhaviya āṇaṃ pavatteti,
mil5.4.1:4.4: evam-eva kho, mahārāja tesaṃ acintiyānaṃ kammavipākaṃ yeva adhimattaṃ balavataraṃ, kammavipākaṃ yeva sabbe abhibhaviya āṇaṃ pavatteti, kammādhiggahitassa avasesā kiriyā okāsaṃ na labhanti.
mil5.4.1:5.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja mahiyā davaḍāhe samuṭṭhite ghaṭasahassam-pi udakaṃ na sakkoti nibbāpetuṃ, atha kho aggi yeva tattha abhibhaviya āṇaṃ pavatteti,
mil5.4.1:5.4: evam-eva kho mahārāja tesaṃ acintiyānaṃ kammavipākaṃ yeva adhimattaṃ balavataraṃ, kammavipākaṃ yeva sabbe abhibhaviya āṇaṃ pavatteti, kammādhiggahitassa avasesā kiriyā okāsaṃ na labhanti. Tasmā mahārāja āyasmato Mahāmoggallānassa kammādhiggahitassa laguḷehi pothiyamānassa iddhiyā samannāhāro nāhosīti. -
mil5.4.1:5.5: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
